metadata.derivation: Derived by SpektraLab from kodak_portra_400 (structure only): Ilford FP4 Plus technical information sheet: Ilfotec HC 1+31 8 min characteristic curve (relative log exposure, anchored at the ISO speed point) and linear spectral sensitivity (wedge spectrogram) Black-and-white profile with three identical channels: characteristic curve and spectral sensitivity digitized from the manufacturer datasheet (base+fog 0.09 removed, log exposure 0 at H = 8.1/ISO with ISO 125); spectrally flat silver density; hanatos2025 adaptation data are the base's.
